Season Validation Report

This version is for auditing the model. It prioritizes evidence tables, drilldowns, and counterfactual comparisons over editorial storytelling.

How to use this report: Start with alternative standings if you want to validate season-level counterfactuals. Then use the team comparison evidence and team drilldowns to inspect the week and player rows behind each aggregate.

Validation Evidence

These sections expose the detailed evidence behind the season metrics.

Alternative Scoring Worlds

This section shows how the league would look under both the notebook scoring systems and the lineup-counterfactual standings systems, so you can compare the real finish to the other ways the season could have been judged.

What to look for: Use Actual Finish as the anchor. Then compare how far each team moves under points-only, F1, top-half, and ideal-lineup systems to see which teams were helped or hurt by the default standings rules and by their own lineup choices.

Transaction Lineup Value Drill-In | Click to inspect team, player, and week totals

How to read this evidence: This view keeps both sides of the transaction story. Added Lineup Value shows what pickups contributed to the best plausible lineup. Moved-Away Follow-Up shows value produced after players moved away, which is context rather than automatic blame. Open a team, then a week, to compare the actual lineup against the transaction-model ideal lineup.

Move Timing vs Week Impact: A week can show transaction value even when no move happened that week. The lineup impact carries forward after a player is added or dropped, so the weekly totals show ongoing effect while the move table only shows transactions executed in that specific week.
